correctness.rationale: The standalone exhaustive verifier computes forty-two perfect matchings, 15,819 faces, 7,905 valid Morse pairs, all 78,921 directed face incidences and a complete acyclic topological sort. Signed integral gradient elimination gives d3=(0,-1,-1,1,0,0), d4=0. A degree-one cell cancellation leaves five three-cells, and the four-cell attaching map vanishes by the Hurewicz isomorphism for the two-connected wedge of three-spheres. Independent mod-two simplicial ranks corroborate. Full verifier replay returned VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: The natural perfect-matching extendability complex of the canonical 18-vertex cubic symmetric Pappus graph has a complete integral homotopy classification, nontrivially concentrated in dimensions 3 and 4 despite pure dimension 8. The 495 minimal nonextendible graph matchings make the contrast with the previously known ordinary matching complex structural, not a renamed deduction. Finite completeness and exact integral homotopy have mathematical value on this natural exact object without a family theorem.
